risks.risk: Whether it is fully functional (prints/copies) vs. parts-only or with faults; photos don’t show a working test.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video/clip: power on → home screen → copy/print a test page → show output coming out clean (no streaks/blank pages).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case) for a used business printer.

risks.risk: Toner/CMYK supply condition (empty/low/expired) and whether all colours are available.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the toner/consumables status screen (showing each colour level) or a photo of toner cartridges installed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if toner may be low/needs replacement.

risks.risk: Paper path issues (jams, misfeeds) and whether all trays/duplex work.
risks.proof: Ask for a clip showing feeding from tray 1 and tray 2 (if present) plus duplex printing (double-sided) without jamming.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if paper handling/duplex may require service.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/options (finisher, bypass tray, network kit, etc.) that affect value.
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo: what options are installed (finisher/stacker, network, extra trays) and what is included in the sale.

risks.risk: Potential scam/overstatement risk: seller text may not match the exact unit condition; only one photo is provided.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo with today’s date + seller’s name/ID next to the printer, and a serial-number close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively due to limited verification.

proof_requests: Video clip: power on + run a colour test page and show the printed output.
Close-up photo of the control panel showing toner/consumables status for all colours.
Clip showing duplex/double-sided printing and feeding from the main tray without jams.
Photos of installed options (any finisher/extra trays/network) and what accessories are included.
Serial number close-up and a dated photo (today) with the seller’s identifier.
response.reason: The exact model (bizhub PRO C754e) is readable from the photo, but there is no proof of working condition, toner status, or paper/duplex functionality—these are the main factors that determine the real market price for a used colour MFP.
